entry.title: SpaceX Lowers IPO Valuation Target | Bloomberg Tech 5/29/2026

entry.title: SpaceX Said to Cut IPO Valuation Goal to at Least $1.8 Trillion
entry.summary: SpaceX is currently targeting a valuation of at least $1.8 trillion in its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, as Elon Musk’s rocket and artificial intelligence company nears its debut.
